text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off... Enticed by the wonderful aroma of broth,
I stepped through the noren curtain of a ramen shop, and—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to run away?
This is a battle meant to be claimed by those of us who bear the title of king—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: From “Who is the King of Kings?! The Ramen King Championship”...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "WRRRROOONG! I said speed-eating ramen lacks the dignity befitting a King!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Still... but I cannot overlook those words!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make you understand! No matter the battle,
the one who wins... will be me, the King of Kings!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Allow me to show you the difference in our calibers.
That I am the King of Kings... the "Supreme Overlord"!
choice_data_list: There's just way too much to poke holes in...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-kun!
Have you come to join the battle of champions as well?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then etch this into your eyes... the moment
I reign supreme as the absolute Overlord!
choice_data_list: ...I'd love to see it in a race!
Got it, I'll see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Quite the passionate pick-up line.
...Right, King-kun?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand.
...We'll settle the rest on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...The strangely heated atmosphere of battle dissipated along with the steam of the ramen."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Without fail... I'll win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the ramen-eating contest that would apparently
determine the king of kings began—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*Slurp! Chew chew!*
I'm winning by... by one slice of naruto—... *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*... Hehehe! That's what happens when you force yourse—... Urgh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SLAAAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having reached their limits, both sank down.
Just as I was wondering how to get them back...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mister Manager~! Two more bowls of the
Ramen King Championship ramen, please~♪

text_block_list.name: Two Kings
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...'There's always someone better.'
I couldn't help staring into the distance thinking that.
